rules: Do not delete the only copy of a credential.
Move local secret files outside the repo manually, then rotate credentials in provider dashboards.
humanSteps: Record paths and detector types only.
Move secret files to a private location outside the repo after backup.
Rotate each credential in its provider dashboard.
Recreate local env files from clean examples.
Run pnpm run verify:no-secrets and pnpm run verify:public-clean-room.
